text:
sarah_sec: vuln-bot just posted an npm audit alert for console-ui on staging. 3 high CVEs, looks like tar (path traversal), ws (client/server), and trace/debug util.

vuln-bot: automated alert: package: tar, severity: high, vulnerable_versions: <6.1.11; package: ws, severity: high, vulnerable_versions: <8.5.3; package: debug, severity: moderate. See https://npmjs.com/advisories for details.

kevin_frontend: seen it. quick question — are the vulnerable versions pulled into the runtime bundle or only dev/build tools?

dan_build: quick grep: tar is in a runtime dep (extract-tgz used by file uploads helper). ws shows up via @realtime/pubsub (runtime). debug is transitive in dev-tooling (storybook).

maria_pm: priority? customer-facing features impacted? any security incidents yet?

sarah_sec: no exploitation observed. prioritize tar and ws as P0 -> they touch runtime. debug is P2 (dev-only).

kevin_frontend: plan: bump direct deps to safe versions, then run a minimal smoke on staging targeting upload flows and websockets. I'll open PR for console-ui runtime deps.

dan_build: FYI patches will cause pnpm-lock churn + possible CJS/ESM bundle diffs. recommend short lockfile-freeze window during merges, and pin to exact versions in resolutions to avoid transient backflow.

sarah_sec: agree. suggest: (1) open PRs for runtime fixes; (2) apply temporary package.json "resolutions" for transitive vuln where we can't upgrade cleanly; (3) run integration in staging; (4) coordinate 30-min freeze when merging.

kevin_frontend: I'll take tar/ws bump. quick patch set: `tar@6.1.11`, `ws@8.5.3`.

dan_build: I'll handle adding resolutions for debug transient and a follow-up to clean dev deps. I'll also run the bundle build to check CJS/ESM outputs: `pnpm -w -r build` then smoke the electron/iframe embeds.

maria_pm: can we get a quick risk note to share with security/compliance? I can file the advisory to the legal/reg team.

sarah_sec: I'll draft a 2-sentence risk summary and tag legal. Also logging: we'll add an audit-log entry for the change and capture the commit hashes for the patch.

kevin_frontend: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/842 (WIP) — bumped tar/ws, added unit check, increased e2e timeout for websocket handshake.

vuln-bot: dependency check: post-PR scan shows debug still flagged in dev deps via `@storybook/*`.

dan_build: resolution for debug added to package.json to quiet CI: "resolutions": {"debug": "4.3.4"}. I'll mark it with a comment in the PR explaining temp nature and follow-up.

sarah_sec: Tests to run before merge: `yarn test:unit`, `yarn test:e2e --grep upload|websocket`, `pnpm -r build && node ./scripts/verify-bundles.js`. If green, we can merge during 30-min freeze.

maria_pm: schedule: 15:00 PST freeze for 30m? Ops channel notified.

kevin_frontend: SGTM. I'll re-run the staging flows after merge and post quick checklist results here.

dan_build: note: to reduce lockfile churn for other teams, I'm going to squash and keep changelog minimal, and avoid regen of unrelated package entries.

sarah_sec: follow-ups: create a postmortem-style short doc in #incidents if anything breaks, and add these CVEs to our triage board with labels (P0-runtime, patch-applied).

kevin_frontend: merged at 15:12 PST, all checks passed except flakey storybook test (dev-only). staging upload + ws smoke passed.

maria_pm: thanks — I'll notify legal and customer success with the risk summary.

sarah_sec: closing the thread — will convert the temporary resolution to proper upgrades in next sprint. :thumbsup:
